title: Napkin AI Playbook: Stop guessing your pricing. Do this instead.
caption:
Stop guessing your pricing. Do this instead.

The exact stack behind this:
1️⃣ Start from plain text — Paste your process as a numbered list — no design file, no blank canvas, no Figma tab.
2️⃣ Choose the visual — It returns flows, funnels, and comparison graphics generated from your own words.
3️⃣ Match your brand — Swap colors and fonts once, export SVG or PNG at slide resolution — nobody guesses it's AI.
4️⃣ Text → diagram — Replace one wall-of-text slide with one diagram. Saves and shares both go up on visual posts.
